truth_source: HABS ILL,16-CHIG,33- (1963). Plan values scaled from sheet 2 (first floor) and sheet 4 (roof outline, registered to sheet 2 by the south garden pier and the stair wall, about 5 px = 0.08 m), heights scaled from the west elevation on sheet 6; all at 20.0 px/ft checked on the scale bars. Scaled, not dimensioned: read to about 0.1 m
truth_note: Ls: enclosure SW corner to the west face of the stair-wall jog, sheet 2 (263 px at 19.98 px/ft). Heights: west elevation, sheet 6, at 19.66 px/ft. Roof: sheet 4 says west edge 5'-9" east of the wall face, north 4'-5" beyond the enclosure, south 1'-10" beyond it; the west elevation says north 3'-1", south 2'-8". rys and ryn take the mean of the two sheets; they disagree by about 0.3 m, which is the tolerance on the roof
